LESSON: FACTORS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.1 Whole Numbers (20 lessons) • Place value and total value • reading a
Topic 1.2: Factors

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Factors
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. solve questions on Factors
2. show clear working for Factors

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Learning Factors

• Read the meaning of Factors.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Factors

Teach
• Use objects, drawings, or place value to understand Factors.
• Write each step. Box the final answer.

Worked example
• Model question on Factors: write the question.
• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …
• (Your teacher/parent can replace this with the class example.)

Try this
• Invent 3 Factors questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Factors question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Factors.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a revision sheet for Factors with 5 worked examples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Show working.
• Check every answer.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
